environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) running directly via gunicorn behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4). Container runtime is standard Docker with default seccomp profile (which allows execve). The process runs as uid 1000 inside the container. No additional syscall filtering or sandboxing is applied. The filesystem at /tmp/uploads is a standard ext4 mount with no restrictions.
